membership.note: 80-stock HSC list as printed on 19 October. IDX publishes HSC notices per issuer. No consolidated official list was found.

method: Full market value = shares outstanding x daily close, from the owner's read-only Flowless database. Group change = sum(shares x close on the later date) / sum(shares x close on the earlier date) - 1. Week is 16 to 23 October, Tuesday to Friday is 19 to 23 October (the 19 October close is the base). Trading share uses regular-market value, 19 to 23 October. These are full-value weights, not IHSG capped free-float weights.
